slides.title:
Build faster
with AI tools that actually help
slides.subtitle:
A practical command-center guide to modern AI tooling for developers:
shipping code, reviewing changes, automating ops, and reducing context switching.

slides.description:
The best AI developer tools reduce context drift.
They connect code, docs, tickets, and logs into one working surface.

items.title: Source-aware search
items.text: Find relevant functions, tickets, and design notes without leaving the editor.

items.title: Live repo map
items.text: See services, dependencies, and ownership before you ask the model to change code.

items.title: Prompt memory
items.text: Reuse project-specific instructions so every run starts closer to the target.

slides.description:
Use AI as a structured collaborator.
Draft, critique, and refine changes in tight loops instead of one-shot prompting.

items.title: Generate a first draft
items.text: Ask for a minimal patch before expanding the scope or abstractions.

items.title: Review like a senior
items.text: Request edge cases, naming fixes, and architecture tradeoffs in the same pass.

items.title: Lock the final diff
items.text: Convert accepted suggestions into a clean patch and keep the rest in notes.

slides.description:
AI tools work best when they are paired with objective checks.
Tests, linting, and type checks keep the assistant honest.

items.title: Pre-flight tests
items.text: Run unit and integration checks before accepting generated changes.

items.title: Type-safe output
items.text: Use schemas and static typing to catch malformed responses early.

items.title: Explain failures
items.text: Have the assistant summarize why a check failed and what to do next.

slides.description:
The most useful AI workflows are repeatable.
Automation turns one-off prompts into reliable team habits.

items.title: Release notes bot
items.text: Summarize merged changes and draft release notes from the pull request.

items.title: Incident helper
items.text: Cluster logs, highlight anomalies, and suggest likely next steps during outages.

items.title: Task router
items.text: Send the right request to the right agent, tool, or teammate automatically.

slides.title:
Turn AI tools
into a calmer dev stack
slides.subtitle:
Pick one workflow, instrument it, and make it repeatable.
That is how the best teams turn AI into leverage instead of noise.
